def: properly, a crow-foot (three-pronged obstruction in war), i.e. (by analogy) a thorny plant (caltrop)

occurrences.text: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
